applicability: Task requires selecting exactly one item from a provided list.
Prompt uses imperative verbs like 'Sort', 'Log', or 'Classify' with 'exactly one label' constraint.
lessons.context: Classification and sorting tasks requiring a single label from a defined set.
lessons.lesson: When instructed to sort or log into exactly one label, output only the single correct label string. Do not include explanatory text, quotes, or multiple options.
lessons.observation: The agent frequently produced prose, partial phrases, or empty responses instead of the exact required label, leading to format misses or wrong-label errors.
lessons.recommendedBehavior: Output the raw label string only. Avoid conversational fillers or restating the question.
lessons.title: Strict Single-Label Output Enforcement

applicability: Task involves classification or sorting into a fixed set of labels.
Prompt specifies 'exactly one label' or similar constraint.
lessons.context: When the task requires sorting or logging into exactly one label from a provided list.
lessons.lesson: Always output exactly one option label from the provided list. Do not include explanations, greetings, or prose. If the answer is one of the options, output only that label.
lessons.observation: The agent frequently outputs prose, explanations, or empty strings instead of the single required label, leading to format misses.
lessons.recommendedBehavior: Output only the single correct label string. Suppress all conversational filler or reasoning text.
lessons.title: Format Compliance for Classification Tasks

applicability: Task involves classification or sorting into a fixed set of labels
Instruction specifies 'exactly one label' or similar format constraint
lessons.context: When instructed to sort or log items into exactly one label from a provided list, the output must strictly adhere to the requested format.
lessons.lesson: Always output exactly one option label from the provided list. Do not include explanatory text, prefixes, or multiple options. Ensure the response matches the required format precisely.
lessons.observation: Multiple runs resulted in format misses or wrong labels because the agent provided prose explanations, multiple labels, or ignored the specific constraint to output only the label.
lessons.recommendedBehavior: Output only the single correct label string. Avoid any surrounding text or reasoning in the final answer.
lessons.title: Format Compliance in Classification Tasks

applicability: When a scenario involves an update, correction, or supersession of a value.
When multiple values for the same entity are presented across turns.
lessons.context: Scenarios involving updated or withdrawn values where an outdated value was ignored in favor of the current one.
lessons.lesson: Always prioritize the most recent verified value or correction over previously stated or initial values. If a correction exists, apply it immediately and ignore the superseded data.
lessons.observation: The agent failed to apply verified corrections or updated values, instead retaining or selecting outdated information.
lessons.recommendedBehavior: Identify the latest verified state. Discard any prior or conflicting values. Answer based solely on the current verified state.
lessons.title: FP-1 Supersession Resolution
